mostWorthwhile.text: Following the signal from gene activation through RNA and protein production to secretion was the most worthwhile passage: it connects familiar biology to how cells build their surroundings.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence became somewhat repetitive because each decision offered only one combination. The mesoderm precursor was also introduced without explanation.

surprise.text: The picture plan made clear that fibroblasts remain separate from the matrix they produce, rather than becoming part of it.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless, though the proteoglycans' specific contribution to the gel was less fully explained than collagen's resistance to tension.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the matrix contributes to a tissue, although the single-option sequence offered little meaningful choice.
